title: PokéMount ride art index - consolidation build, 2026-11-23
provenance: PokéMount Custom Sprite Sets by Ulithium_Dragon (PokeCommunity thread "PokéMount Custom Sprite Sets", 2017; author's terms: free to be used by anyone for anything). Sheets fetched by Riley from the thread on 2026-11-23 (the pack exists nowhere else) and cleaned by the PokéMount cleanup build: fitted-grid slice, /6 box downscale from the ~6x oversampled relay copies, palette snap; frames are faithful reconstructions, not bit-exact originals. Used under the Solid Rule (Riley, 2026-11-23); provenance recorded.

mounts_missing.reason: 6 of the original 14 PokeMount species were not among Riley's 2026-11-23 fetch (the sheets exist only as images inside the same PokeCommunity thread) and stay on the FOR RILEY TO FETCH list; when they arrive they go through the same cleanup recipe and join this index. Torkoal, Latios and Latias joined in binding build 3 from the in-house surf production (produced sets, PARTIAL finish) — the fetched originals supersede them when they arrive.

remaining_step: Scene display hooks are NOT part of this binding: the frames and this registry are in the pack, but no overworld scene renders PokéMount art yet. Wiring a mount renderer into the ride scenes is the remaining step, flagged here and in the build report.

IN-HOUSE PRODUCED (surf production lane, 2026-11-23) under PRODUCTION_SCOPE.md tier 3: the PokéMount Torkoal sheet (tier 1) is still on Riley's fetch list and the Pokémon Ranger lava-ride sprite (tier 2) needs a Ranger ROM that is not held, so the set was produced from Torkoal's held PMD SpriteCollab Walk art (CHUNSOFT game sprite, the pack's bound follower source) with the bound water-surf bob cycle as the motion template, an in-house generic rider in the bound sets' palette/scale, and lava-surface lighting (warm under-light at the waterline) as the one deliberate deviation the scope specifies. If the fetched PokéMount sheet later lands, it supersedes this set through the normal cleanup + QA route. NOTE for the binding build: the set name resolves to the loader's 'land' variant; Torkoal carries exactly one set, so the loader's single-set rule serves it for the surf context (the same reading swampert_male_female already ships under).

IN-HOUSE PRODUCED (surf production lane, 2026-11-23) under PRODUCTION_SCOPE.md: no 2D air/sky-surf pack exists in any community checked across two hunt rotations, and the scope's named analogue (the PokéMount Flygon set) is itself on the fetch list, not held — so the set was produced from Latios's held PMD SpriteCollab Walk art (CHUNSOFT game sprite; the Walk cycle is a genuine glide in all four facings) in the bound PokéMount format, with an in-house generic rider in the bound sets' palette/scale and the ground-shadow/altitude convention specced from the mount system's presentation (offset soft shadow ellipse, static while the body bobs). Latios is a male-only species; the set follows the luxray single-gender precedent with a Flash-sparkle second block. Air is not a loader ride context today: the set name resolves to the 'land' variant and the single-set rule serves it for any context until a soaring mode is wired.
